2026-SD-GOV.note: Governor and Lieutenant Governor. Polymarket's event is titled "South Dakota Governor Election Winner" and resolves on the winner of the 2026 South Dakota gubernatorial election; it offers Dan Ahlers (D) and Larry Rhoden (R), plus eleven placeholder outcomes (Option A to J, Other) that are not open for trading, which ballot/odds.py's open_only reading leaves out. About $26,700 traded when checked. Kalshi's event is titled "South Dakota Governor winner?" (In 2026); its two markets are by party, labelled Dan Ahlers and Larry Rhoden, about 9,200 contracts when checked. Both name the candidates for governor without running mates. Left out on purpose: Polymarket's margin-of-victory market, and Kalshi's finished markets on the Republican nomination, the primary and the runoff's margin.

2026-SD-AG.note: Attorney General. Kalshi's event is titled "South Dakota Attorney General winner?" (In 2026); its two markets are by party, one labelled Lance Russell and one "Democratic party". Our list has Lance Russell alone: no Democrat is on the November list, yet the Democratic market shows a last price of 10 cents (standing offers about 5 cents) on 121 contracts, and Russell's 97 cents on 17 contracts. Ask John before showing this market: it is barely traded and prices a party with no candidate on the ballot. Polymarket lists no market for this race (its search for South Dakota and the likely slug, 2026-10-02).

2026-SD-SOS.note: Secretary of State. Kalshi's event is titled "South Dakota Secretary of State winner?" (in 2026), one market per candidate: Heather Baxter, Tamara J. Lesnar and Terrence Davis, the three on our list. It opened September 13, 2026 and has all but never traded: under two contracts when checked, all on Davis at 54 cents, while the standing offers were 85 to 95 cents for Baxter and 2 to 10 cents for each of the others. Baxter's and Lesnar's markets had never traded, so ballot/odds.py's traded_only reading would show Davis alone at 54%. Ask John before showing this market: two contracts are not a price, and the one shown would mislead. Polymarket lists no market for this race (its search for South Dakota and the likely slug, 2026-10-02).
